title: Split PDF Documents Locally
description: Split PDF files by individual pages, extract specific pages, or set page ranges securely in your browser sandbox.
dragDropPlaceholder: Drag & drop a PDF file here, or click to upload
splitAllLabel: Split every page into a separate document
invalidFileError: File is corrupted or not a valid PDF document.
emptyFileError: Please upload a PDF document first.
invalidRangeError: Page range is invalid or exceeds the document's total pages.
successMessage: PDF split successfully! Downloading extract archives.
downloadPrompt: If download does not start automatically, click here.

faq.a: You can input single pages (e.g. 5) or page ranges (e.g. 1-3), separated by commas. Double spaces are automatically trimmed. Page numbers start at 1.

faq.q: Is there a page limit for splits?
faq.a: All page extractions happen locally. For documents exceeding 100 pages, splitting all pages individually may cause a temporary browser delay. Extracting specific ranges is recommended for large files.
